recognize_zh: 高倍下右半部為卵圓至紡錘形核、胞質豐富的細胞，CD25 呈棕色細胞膜與細胞質陽性；左側小圓核的淋巴球則完全陰性，顯示肥大細胞異常表現 CD25。
features: Oval to elongated spindle-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant cytoplasm in the positive population
Moderate granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD25 staining outlining cell borders
Sharp demarcation from an adjacent cluster of small round CD25-negative lymphocytes
Positive cells arranged in a loose streaming sheet along the edge of the core
Occasional strongly stained small round cells (likely nonspecific or other positive cells)
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow trephine immunostained for CD25 shows a sheet of cells with oval to spindled nuclei and abundant cytoplasm displaying moderate membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD25 positivity. The positive population is sharply demarcated from an adjacent cluster of small round lymphocytes that are CD25 negative, serving as an internal negative control. Aberrant CD25 expression by spindled cells in this distribution is consistent with neoplastic mast cells of systemic mastocytosis, provided mast cell lineage is confirmed by tryptase or CD117 staining.

ddx.vs: Hairy cell leukemia is CD25 positive but consists of round-oval B cells (CD20, annexin A1 positive) in an interstitial fried-egg pattern and is tryptase negative.
CD25-positive T cells are small to medium lymphoid cells that coexpress CD3, lacking spindle morphology and tryptase.
Stromal spindle cells are CD25 and tryptase negative and have wavy, thin nuclei without abundant granular cytoplasm.
